actions.reason: RNA shows a coherent metabolic/secretory downregulation, but WXS and CNV provide no FDR-significant support, cross-modal silhouettes are near zero with many zero-support patients, and no technical confound is significant. The set lacks a defensible multi-modal identity; no available extra evidence can resolve this gap, and structural metrics do not support split or merge.

Only one RNA pathway (EMT) is significant, WXS and CNV are not significant, cross-modal support is low (median support 1, no all-positive patients), and structural boundaries are weak. The evidence is insufficient for a supported non-terminal action; no resolvable evidence gap exists.

No significant biological enrichment in any modality after FDR correction, cross-modal support is uneven (only WSI positive), and structural metrics show weak fused cohesion despite high resampling ARI. The set lacks a robust molecular identity; no available extra evidence can change this.

RNA shows multiple FDR-significant upregulated pathways, CNV shows significant copy-number losses on chr7 and chr20, and cross-modal consistency is moderate with positive WSI and RNA silhouettes and high patient support. Technical confounds are not significant at set level. The evidence supports a defensible multi-modal identity without a dominant technical explanation.

RNA shows broad immune downregulation, but WXS and CNV are not significant, cross-modal silhouettes are weak, and no technical confound is significant. The set lacks independent genomic corroboration and multi-modal cohesion; no available extra evidence can resolve this gap.

A significant CJ site confound (q=0.049) further undermines biological interpretation. The evidence is insufficient for a supported non-terminal action.
